lab_questions.title: Double-Entry Ledger Posting & Fiscal Period Immutability
lab_questions.description: The core financial module of an enterprise ERP system allows journal entries to be posted with unbalanced debits and credits, and permits retroactive modifications to closed financial quarters.
lab_questions.startup_command: python manage.py migrate && python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8010

tasks.title: Double-Entry Balancing & Atomic Journal Posting
tasks.description:
The `POST /api/ledger/journal-entries/` endpoint accepts line items without verifying mathematical balance. An entry with $500 Debit and $300 Credit gets committed, corrupting the general ledger.

**Goal:** Enforce double-entry bookkeeping rules in serializer validation and view logic. Verify that `sum(lines.debit_amount) == sum(lines.credit_amount)`. Atomically persist the header and all child lines inside `transaction.atomic()`. Reject unbalanced requests with `400 Bad Request` or `422 Unprocessable Entity` without leaving orphan database rows.

tasks.title: Closed Fiscal Period Immutability
tasks.description:
Users can post journal entries dated inside past, audited fiscal periods or edit historical journal entries, violating compliance regulations.

**Goal:** Intercept create, update, and delete operations on `JournalEntry`. Look up the matching `FiscalPeriod` based on the entry's `posting_date`. If `fiscal_period.is_closed == True`, reject the request with `403 Forbidden` (`{"error": "CANNOT_POST_TO_CLOSED_PERIOD"}`). Only allow operations where `fiscal_period.is_closed == False`.

tasks.title: Foreign Currency Revaluation & Unrealized FX Offset
tasks.description:
Foreign currency accounts (e.g., EUR bank balance on a USD base ledger) are reported at original booking rates, causing discrepancies on periodic financial statements.

**Goal:** Implement `POST /api/ledger/accounts/{id}/revalue/`. Calculate the difference between the account's historical base-currency balance and its current balance converted using the latest `ExchangeRate`. Automatically post an offsetting balancing entry to the system's `Unrealized FX Gain/Loss` account.
